sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with Special G.R. Case No.06 of 2020 pending in the Court of learned Addl. District Judge- cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Sundargarh,
arising out of Talsara P.S. Case No.05 of 2020 for commission of offence punishable under Sections 450/342/376(2)(n) IPC and Section 6/17 of the POCSO Act.

entities.text: Addl. District Judge- cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Sundargarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel that the Petitioner submits that he had no instruction that his Client moved this Court in ABLAPL No.5002 of 2020 which was rejected by order dated 24.11.2020.
4. On perusal of the ABLAPL the same evidently does not find place as the Petitioner did not instruct the counsel.
5. Taking into account such conduct of the Petitioner, this Court is not inclined to entertain this ABLAPL.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge PKS Signed by: PRADEEP KUMAR SWAIN
